title: Night Owl or Early Bird?
body: Suriya and Meghna are Data $$100$$ students, and they have a prediction task where we wish to predict whether people are night owls or early birds using their favorite color. They're given a shortened training set with $$5$$ data points where $$X$$ is the list of colors blue, green, pink, purple, red, and they wish to predict\n$$y=(0, 1, 1, 1, 0)$$
